## Application Window

- **Title Bar**
  - Application name: "LibreOffice Writer"
  - Document name: "nda_contract.odt - LibreOffice Writer"
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 17:15"
  - System controls: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons on the right

- **Top Menu Bar**
  - Menu items: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Table, Form, Tools, Window, Help

- **Toolbar**

- **Tab Navigation**

  ### New Section
  - Label: "New Section"

  ### Link
  - Checkbox: "Link" (unchecked)

  ### Write Protection
  - Checkbox: "Protect" (unchecked)

  ### Hide
  - Checkbox: "Hide" (unchecked)
  - Label: "With Condition"

  ### Properties

- **Dialog Buttons**
  - "Help" (left)
  - "Reset", "Cancel", "Insert" (right)
